services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Our hands-on exhibits and electrifying demonstrations will help bring classroom concepts to life. Best part? At the Maryland Science Center, all Maryland schools visit for FREE! Our three exhibit floors provide unique learning experiences that amplify scientific discovery and reinforce classroom concepts. Thanks to Science Beyond the Classroom, Powered by Constellation, all Maryland students, teachers, and chaperones can explore our core exhibits for FREE when visiting on a field trip. Non-Maryland schools receive a discounted rate. Free admission support is also provided by the Maryland State Department of Education, The Kahlert Foundation, Transamerica Foundation, Prince George’s County

services.name: Adult Programs Facilitator
services.desc: Join us as we create engaging events to help adults experience MSC their way! Adult (21+) events take place once a month and have additional special activities centered around a theme-like Music Under the Dome, Grown-Up Field Trips, or Wine and Dinosaurs. Volunteers will work a station with an activity in 4-hour

services.name: Family Science Night Educator
services.desc: The Family Science Night program is part of the Maryland Science Center’s outreach programs. Family Science Nights take place during after school time in elementary and middle schools across the state of Maryland. Volunteers of this program facilitate hands-on STEM activities for students and their family members.

services.name: Ticket Add-ons
services.desc: Add an IMAX documentary to your exhibit ticket for just $5 more. All guests, including members, can choose their IMAX showing and purchase their IMAX tickets at the ticket desk upon arrival. Check out our full IMAX schedule and plan your trip
